repo_notes.content: Skip generated and run-artifact paths when reading the code: results/, experiments/**/results/, docs/recordings/, data/pages/viewer/, docs/assets/, and large *.jsonl or *.ndjson files (ledgers, memory mirrors, event streams). They are run outputs or built bundles, not source.

The deterministic Boredom Meter in boredom_meter/meter.py decides the swarm regime (EXPLOIT, BOREDOM_SNAP, PARADIGM_BREAKOUT, CONVERGED). Repository rules live in AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/caffeinated-workflow/SKILL.md.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What the project is: an autoresearch-style swarm with a Boredom Meter, CPU testcases, and the Lab replay viewer; how the pieces fit.

pages.title: Swarm orchestration
pages.purpose: swarm.py, llm.py, runtime_env.py and prompts/: conductor, workers, critic, rounds, ledger and resume.

pages.title: Boredom Meter
pages.purpose: boredom_meter/ and boredom.py: descriptor novelty, stagnation, regimes, gates and task boredom profiles.

pages.title: Research and memory
pages.purpose: research.py, literature.py and memory.py: Exa research, past.dev and local memory, arm isolation.

pages.title: Sandboxed testcases
pages.purpose: testcases/ and held_out.py: the Docker sandbox, hadamard19, bixbench_mini, playworld_mini and held-out grading.

pages.title: Ig Nobel task
pages.purpose: testcases/ignobel/: pre-registration, citation checks, split-half consistency and the judging committee.

pages.title: Viewer export and live publishing
pages.purpose: export_viewer.py, live_publish.py and viewer/: the swarm-viewer/v1 bundle and its live API.

pages.title: Lab backend
pages.purpose: backend/: recording catalog, replay adapter and launch endpoints.

pages.title: Lab frontend
pages.purpose: src/, index.html and vite.config.ts: the Lab replay UI, live follow, score chart and boredom views.

pages.title: Experiments and results
pages.purpose: experiments/ and docs/results.md: A/B harness, confirmatory runs and memory comparison, read from the README and RESULTS docs.

pages.title: Pages site and tooling
pages.purpose: scripts/, Makefile and .github/workflows/: make check, Pages build and CI.
